scripts.dev: bun run src/scripts/prebuild.ts && bun run db:migrate:local && astro dev
scripts.db:migrate:local: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply andersogkristine-gallery --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: bunx wrangler d1 migrations apply andersogkristine-gallery --remote
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bunx wrangler deploy
scripts.ci: bun run src/scripts/prebuild.ts && biome ci . && bun run check && bun test && bun run build
